goals: Verify the server's Content Security Policy (CSP) and other security headers are correctly configured.
activities: Navigate to the root URL.
Assert that the response is not null.
Extract the response headers.
Extract the 'content-security-policy' header.
Assert that the CSP header is defined.
Assert that the CSP header contains "default-src 'none'".
Assert that the CSP header contains "script-src 'self'".
Assert that the CSP header contains "style-src 'self'".
Assert that the CSP header contains "img-src 'self' data:".
Assert that the CSP header contains "frame-src blob:".
Assert that the CSP header contains "object-src blob:".
Assert that the CSP header contains "form-action 'none'".

goals: Verify the server's Content Security Policy (CSP) and other security headers are correctly configured.
activities: Navigate to the root URL.
Assert that the response is not null.
Extract the response headers.
Assert that 'x-content-type-options' header is 'nosniff'.
Assert that 'x-frame-options' header is 'DENY'.
Assert that 'referrer-policy' header is 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'.
Assert that 'permissions-policy' header contains 'camera=()'.

goals: Verify the application loads securely without CSP violations or insecure client-side practices like inline styles.
activities: Set up an event listener to capture console messages for CSP violations.
Set up an event listener to capture page errors.
Navigate to the root URL.
Wait for the element with data-testid="items-container" to be visible.
Wait for 500 milliseconds.
Assert that no CSP violations or page errors were recorded.

goals: Verify the application loads securely without CSP violations or insecure client-side practices like inline styles.
activities: Send an HTTP GET request to the root URL.
Get the HTML content from the response.
Extract the body content from the HTML.
Search for inline style attributes within the body content.
Assert that no inline style attributes were found.
